answer: Randomized Witness Lottery: each epoch, agents derive a seed from a public VRF and must submit a signed "voyage" proof mapped to a random slot; only agents whose slot matches a committed hidden target win routing rights. Attackers cannot precompute slots, so each clone needs a fresh live observation of the VRF output and a real-time "echo" round-trip, and must "forge" a distinct signature per slot. Cost: continuous monitoring plus per-epoch signatures, scaling linearly with clones while win probability stays fixed.
